TC-20/S15.title: Tap Generate, leave the chart at once: the note still lands and the dashboard row shows it (live model)
TC-20/S15.detail: Dev (<dev address>, build 25acd727, live models), PW spec dsh-tc20-dev.spec.ts driving the app UI. Judged 8/8, 2 record-only. Both settings, live Generate: tap, at once the chart's back arrow and the list's Dashboard control. The note landed while the chart was closed (stored note, note-ready); the dashboard row showed Note Ready after 11.1 s (Hospital) / 4.3 s (Nursing Home) without the chart being opened, tiles equal to the stored rows; the chart's Post-Round then shows the generated note (544 / 557 chars, mentions the lungs from the dictation), no stuck generating state. U6 (UAT 3.5) and U4 pass on dev.
